author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I wonder what LLM or SLM Phison runs on their platform.  It would be nice if the marketing posts come with some technical footnote for the engineers.

#amdbrandambassadors

reshared_post.reshared_text:
Phison saw smaller organizations struggle with AI costs and set out to make it affordable and adaptable. Phison’s aiDAPTIV+ pairs NAND flash with AMD EPYC CPUs to create accessible AI platforms. With AMD EPYC CPUs and NAND flash, Phison opens AI access, lowers costs, and fuels innovation.

“…this is really empowered by AMD solutions, both with the EPYC CPUs and the wide range of GPUs.”
- Sebastien Jean, CTO, Phison Electronics USA
